intro.passwordRecovery: Use the code below to reset your password.

home.eyebrowText: One console for your entire terminal estate
home.title: Empower every payment terminal you ship.
home.sub: PEP is Newland's partner console — provision devices, push firmware and apps, onboard merchants and watch fleet health, all from one place.
home.capabilitiesLede: From the loading dock to the lane — a single source of truth for every device, build and merchant under your contract.

deviceFleet.title: Device fleet
deviceFleet.desc: Provision, group and monitor every terminal you ship — serial, IMEI, firmware and live status in one register.

firmware.title: Firmware & apps
firmware.desc: Stage builds, target by model or store, and roll out over-the-air with staged deployments and rollback.

merchants.title: Merchants & stores
merchants.desc: Onboard merchants, organise stores, and assign devices down to the lane — with per-merchant entitlements.

diagnostics.title: Remote diagnostics
diagnostics.desc: FlyDesk remote sessions, health snapshots and one-tap reboot when a lane goes dark at 2 a.m.

geo.title: Geolocation & fence
geo.desc: Track device location and draw geofences — get alerted the moment hardware leaves its assigned site.

alerts.title: Pre-warning alerts
alerts.desc: Battery, connectivity and tamper signals surfaced before they become a support ticket.

domain.title: Custom domain
domain.desc: Your operators sign in at your own domain.

branding.title: Custom branding
branding.desc: Your logo on the portal and on terminal boot.

sso.title: Enterprise SSO
sso.desc: Bring your own IdP — Google, Microsoft, Okta, SAML.

home.ctaBandText: Sign in with your work account, or accept an invitation from your administrator to get started.

partner.empty: No partner workspace is available for this account.
partner.defaultError: The partner could not be selected. Please try again.

login.title: Sign in to PEP
login.subtitle: Partner console for {by}.
login.demoHint: Demo: any email + 6-char password. Try {accounts} or an SSO domain (acmepay.com, verakiosk.com).

sso.suspended: SSO is paused for {partner}. Use password sign-in while an admin restores the contract.

errors.passwordMin: Password must be at least 6 characters.
errors.AUTH_BAD_CREDENTIALS: Your email or password is incorrect. Please try again.
errors.generic: Sign in failed. Please try again.

idp.consent: {provider} will return a signed id_token with your verified email and a stable sub. PEP validates it server-side — your password is never shared.

mfa.title: Enter your verification code
mfa.subTotp: Open your {hint} and enter the 6-digit code for PEP.
mfa.hintDemo: Demo: enter any 6 digits to continue.
mfa.hintBad: This scenario rejects 000000 — five wrong tries triggers a lockout.
mfa.errWrong: That code is incorrect. {count} tries remaining before lockout.

company.title: Choose a company
company.sub: Your account has access to multiple companies. Pick one to continue — you can switch later from the console.
company.note: Each company scopes your role independently.

locked.title: Your account is locked
locked.body: This account has been locked for security. An administrator must unlock it before you can sign in again.

ratelimit.title: Too many sign-in attempts
ratelimit.body: You've reached the maximum number of sign-in attempts. For your security, you can try again in about 1 hour.

mfa.title: Verification locked
mfa.body: Too many incorrect codes were entered. This sign-in has been locked for security. Try again later or contact your administrator.

nocompany.title: No company to enter
nocompany.body: You're signed in, but your account isn't a member of any company yet. Companies are invite-only — ask an administrator to send you an invitation. You can't join one on your own.

email.title: Reset your password
email.sub: Enter the email on your account and we'll send a 6-digit verification code.
email.label: Work email

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.sub: Choose a strong password you don't use anywhere else.

done.title: Password updated
done.sub: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new credentials.

invalid.title: Invitation not found
invalid.sub: The link ({token}) doesn't match any pending invitation. It may have been cancelled, used, or expired.

landing.title: Join {partner}
landing.sub: You've been invited to join the PEP partner console. Choose how to continue.
landing.signOutOther: Sign out & use a different account

register.inviteSub: {email} — already confirmed by opening the invite.
register.customSub: Enter the new address next, then verify it with a 6-digit code.
register.newEmailHint: A 6-digit code will confirm you own this address.
register.loginErr: Lowercase letters, digits, . _ - (2–31 chars, start with a letter).
register.loginHint: Used to sign in. Lowercase letters, digits and . _ - only.
register.countryHint: Used for compliance routing (locale, audit jurisdiction).
register.displayHint: Appears in audit logs and to colleagues.

confirm.title: Join {partner}
confirm.sub: Confirm you want to join with the account below. An administrator assigns your access after you join.

welcome.title: Welcome to PEP, {name}.
welcome.sub: You're now a member of {partner}. We've recorded your sign-up time and the roles you accepted.

notFound.title: We can't find that page
notFound.sub: The link may be broken, or the page may have been moved. Let's get you back on track.
